name: worker_postgrest_schema_cache_failure
description: PGRST002 — PostgREST could not query the database for the schema cache. With no valid cache PostgREST serves NOTHING: every RPC and table read fails, get_flag() fails, and the /api/v1 gate fails closed. Sole precise signal for the 2026-08-11 P0 (11m39s of service_unavailable on /api/v1/verify, nothing paged). Measured false-positive budget: a 30-day census on 2026-08-11 found 341 matching entries in exactly two clusters (128 on 2026-08-02, 213 on 2026-08-11) and zero on every other day.
